This reads as a usage question. Rich's table column options are described in the [tables docs](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/tables.rst). Set `no_wrap` and `overflow` on the last column, and `min_width` on the other columns so the table cannot shrink them below their content. Setting `no_wrap=True` alone lets the table shrink the other columns, which is related to #2890.

For usage questions, please ask in [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions).
